articles.title: PHP Fixes Two Critical RCE Vulnerabilities Allowing Unauthenticated Code Execution
articles.summary:
PHP released emergency security updates to address two critical vulnerabilities that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on vulnerable servers. These vulnerabilities are tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, and both have a CVSS v4.0 score of 9.2. The fixes are included in PHP versions 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35. articles.summary:

articles.title: GoDaddy Revokes 404,607 SSL Certificates Following Certificate Issuance Error
articles.summary:
GoDaddy has revoked 404,607 SSL/TLS certificates after discovering that certain subscriber certificates were issued outside the defined profiles in its Certification Practice Statement (CPS) and Certificate Policy (CP).
